name: lumen-desktop
description: Lumen Secure desktop app (Windows, macOS): the bundled Lumen web client in a hardened Electron shell
author: Lumen

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:icons && npm run build:app
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:win:appx: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win appx --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
